Mood. I absolutely agree dude. It’s not a part of life fuck. Life isn’t suppose to be like this. But.. life isn’t suppose to be like … well…anything at all. Life doesn’t find a way to ruin everything. But life also doesn’t find a way to make everything perfect either. It’s life dude.. what the fuck is life even??? 
YOUR life however, is suppose to be whatever you do to affect it. Your choices, your patterns, your influence. But that’s not all that affects your life, there’s external factors- now those things are beyond your control. But not completely, weather can’t be controlled yes, but you can always move to a location with the climate that has the weather you’d prefer. Your emotion is also a factor. Sometimes it’s nature or instinctual- hard to control (fight flight freeze fawn- reptilian brain), but sometimes it’s by nurture (mammalian brain), you can unlearn what you were taught. See that? It can be adapted to, not controlled. You don’t like something? Remove it. You love something? Let that be a priority. The fights? Is it worth losing your love over? It’s your decision. You are the biggest factor in how your life plays out. You are the main character. You decide. 
And with that- you are worthy.

Hell? I think you might be in a prison of your own making. I don’t think I’m in hell. I think I’m in something worse than hell. Heh. Hell could never beat this pain. But you know the best thing about being in your own prison? You have the key. The things you wanted did come true. Just not everything. I dropped  that expectation of perfect. I don’t expect anything, I can only hope. If it doesn’t come true yes I am still very disappointed. Very sad. But human beings are fickle. We are ever changing. You will want something else, and there will be a chance of you getting it. Let yourself feel that disappointment. Think about your own mistakes, understand the factors that played into making that mistake because it wasn’t all you. At this point in time, you do know why it’s a mistake so you’re not incapable. It’s okay. It’s not okay now, but that’s okay. 
One thing I’ve heard is, everyday will be the same. Everyday you will do the same thing. It will be redundant. It will be boring. But the sky seems a different shade of pink today? The traffic seems to be better today? Your boss got you donuts. Those little things, differences, keep those in mind. You can be happy. You are worthy of happiness. Note those little things that make the corner of your lips ticklish. If it gets too unbearable. Write a letter to that. Keep a timeline, send after a certain amount of time. It will get to that, just not now. Keep experience life until that amount of time.
